Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a fundamental error in interpreting the term "pure dominant." In genetics, a "pure" dominant plant is homozygous dominant (RR), not heterozygous (Rr). The agent incorrectly assumed the round-seed parent was heterozygous (Rr), leading to the conclusion that the offspring would be 50% round and 50% wrinkled. Since the parent is actually RR, the cross is RR × rr, resulting in 100% heterozygous (Rr) offspring, all of which will have round seeds. Therefore, the correct answer is A, not B.
